title: hieracium subsenile
intro: Hieracium subsenile, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Hieracium subsenile include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium subsenile include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
